newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish shares close lower in continuous trade.

text.p: Stalexport and Universal closed lower, Budimex closed higher and Elektrim held flat in Warsaw bourse continuous trade on Tuesday. Six stocks did not trade.
Total turnover was 0.8 million zlotys, down from Monday's 1.7 million zlotys.
NFI units rose 3.5 percent to 140.3 zlotys in a turnover of 13 million zlotys, up from Monday's 10 million zlotys.
